definition: Aaron Courville is the co-author of the 'Deep Learning' textbook and Professor at Mila.
details: Co-authored the canonical 'Deep Learning' textbook (with Goodfellow and Bengio), co-authored the original GAN paper, and researches RL and multimodal AI.

explainer.lead: Aaron Courville is a computer scientist. His work spans deep learning and informatics.

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, Carnegie Mellon University
